basics.name: Jiaxi (Jay) Liu
basics.summary: My research focuses on cooperative perception, vehicle-road-cloud integration, and language-model-assisted autonomous driving.
basics.label: Ph.D. Candidate in Civil & Environmental Engineering
basics.lab: Connected & Autonomous Transportation Systems Laboratory (CATS Lab)

work.summary: Research on cooperative perception, vehicle-road-cloud integration systems, and LLM-assisted autonomous driving.

education.detail: Also earned a second bachelor’s degree in Economics.

interests.name: Cooperation under limited communication
interests.description: Identifying safety-relevant blind spots and deciding when, with whom, and what to share.

interests.name: Sensing beyond the vehicle
interests.description: Using roadside infrastructure and UWB measurements to reconstruct work zones and support connected driving.

interests.name: Language-guided driving
interests.description: Combining vision-language reasoning with trajectory prediction, planning, and vehicle control.
